company.description:
Grabb-It is a location based advertising platform that allows advertisers the opportunity to reach the consumers near the point of purchase. 

Grabb-It can strategically place your message in front of millions of shoppers around malls, high traffic venues and events giving advertisers an opportunity to reach a highly captive audience. Grabb-It achieves driving the message to a hyper targeted audience by tapping in to the ride sharing economy where digital advertising and static OOH signage fails.
